name: Andy Ngo
subject: Help me bring Antifa to justice
body:
I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs

| |
---
| |
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztk5o8dv6613jc65e20b5kq0lnje1i9o15jjoghg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs)
---
My fellow concerned American, I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs.And unless we do something to stop them today, I won’t be the last. **[I’m asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me bring Antifa and its members who assaulted me to justice.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zu11ldm8d40jm0bm6hr65ciatrsumvrsku6tumn8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs) ****I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in Portland, Oregon during the summer of 2019.** This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc and violence before.I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist to document and report on their “protest.”As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.The mob was angry, and violence always follows Antifa. Most of them wore masks to prevent being identified when they commit crimes. Many had on helmets and carried riot gear. Some, I later learned, secretly had weapons like baseball bats, brass knuckles and even bricks.I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.**People like you needed to know what was happening.** But I didn't go unnoticed for long.Somebody recognized me and bashed me on the back of my head in an ambush."F*** you, Andy Ngo!" shouted voices around me. "Go home, fascist!"**Fists started flying at my face and head. Then came the projectiles.** Before I knew it, I was being repeatedly punched, kicked, and hit with objects.I tried to protect my head. I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.The thugs robbed me of my camera so that I wouldn’t have evidence of the assault. What they did to me is unacceptable and criminal. And now they're trying to do the same to other innocent Americans like you.That's why I sued members of the Rose City Antifa organization to bring them to justice and send the loud clear message that they are NOT above the law.Now I need your help to hold their feet to the fire and make sure justice is served. [**Will you donate $35 or more to help me hold Antifa accountable?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zr9csfe0t2o2dcjoinb5f5gqslcqv5kjb8mmutf0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs) This is bigger than me alone. After I got away from the mob, police finally showed up when I was in the hospital. But my attackers stole my evidence and nearly silenced me permanently with a traumatic brain injury.Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured part of the attack, clear as day.I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.Wrong.To this day, six years later, the Portland Police have done nothing.**No charges. No arrests. No suspects questioned.** It's not much of a surprise, though.Radical politicians have long since bowed to the dangerous left-wing mobs that terrorize their streets. That’s why the Center for American Liberty helped me file a lawsuit against my attackers. A judge ordered three of them to pay damages – but more than a year later and they have not paid a dime.So now the Center for American Liberty is helping me track them down and make them pay for nearly killing me and trampling upon the First Amendment.Unfortunately it’s going to cost at least $20,000 to get justice.[**That's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my efforts to hold Antifa and its members accountable.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zk130q4n3cl1q90sb6vvk0vmi8lcre8079qgtb58_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs) We have to stop Antifa and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.Antifa wants the literal end of America -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse – open violent anarchists who want to tear down civilization and remake it in their own twisted vision with no law and order.By any means necessary.**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. They did that with BLM. They’re doing it now against ICE.It's a sick strategy, but very smart – because so far, they've been successful.**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free.** Our politicians and media are treating this terrorist group like peaceful protestors!As we saw in Los Angeles earlier this summer, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continue to escape consequences.**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands – with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt5edln3lo0hnk6gk2toagqrp54k4n87lieqfvs8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs) Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't.This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable. **[Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to help me get justice from Antifa?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z85ljrv0h7ejr0ukui5adb475a01qvr5cs728clo_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chh69o34c3h2bs) **Please don't wait – if we don't fight back and win now, **these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America** , destroying everything and everyone in their path. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---

---
**Andy Ngo**

Today, we can make them face the consequences that left-wing politicians refuse to dole out. name: Andy Ngo
subject: Help me bring Antifa to justice
body:
I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs

| |
---
| |
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0kdhhqh0j3bgdkqkmo5kgg410q1ht7aaj3853kg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs)
---
My fellow concerned American, I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs.And unless we do something to stop them today, I won’t be the last. **[I’m asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me bring Antifa and its members who assaulted me to justice.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd9c4s9ujcu7u6t05cpf404j3799t02v5i46t0i8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs) ****I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in Portland, Oregon during the summer of 2019.** This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc and violence before.I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist to document and report on their “protest.”As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.The mob was angry, and violence always follows Antifa. Most of them wore masks to prevent being identified when they commit crimes. Many had on helmets and carried riot gear. Some, I later learned, secretly had weapons like baseball bats, brass knuckles and even bricks.I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.**People like you needed to know what was happening.** But I didn't go unnoticed for long.Somebody recognized me and bashed me on the back of my head in an ambush."F*** you, Andy Ngo!" shouted voices around me. "Go home, fascist!"**Fists started flying at my face and head. Then came the projectiles.** Before I knew it, I was being repeatedly punched, kicked, and hit with objects.I tried to protect my head. I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.The thugs robbed me of my camera so that I wouldn’t have evidence of the assault. What they did to me is unacceptable and criminal. And now they're trying to do the same to other innocent Americans like you.That's why I sued members of the Rose City Antifa organization to bring them to justice and send the loud clear message that they are NOT above the law.Now I need your help to hold their feet to the fire and make sure justice is served. [**Will you donate $35 or more to help me hold Antifa accountable?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziu4jo93o21gr41scd2dmalie8vmaadri0o0r3v0_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs) This is bigger than me alone. After I got away from the mob, police finally showed up when I was in the hospital. But my attackers stole my evidence and nearly silenced me permanently with a traumatic brain injury.Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured part of the attack, clear as day.I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.Wrong.To this day, six years later, the Portland Police have done nothing.**No charges. No arrests. No suspects questioned.** It's not much of a surprise, though.Radical politicians have long since bowed to the dangerous left-wing mobs that terrorize their streets. That’s why the Center for American Liberty helped me file a lawsuit against my attackers. A judge ordered three of them to pay damages – but more than a year later and they have not paid a dime.So now the Center for American Liberty is helping me track them down and make them pay for nearly killing me and trampling upon the First Amendment.Unfortunately it’s going to cost at least $20,000 to get justice.[**That's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my efforts to hold Antifa and its members accountable.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvpoioetj1ord94ilt8p1mke7l24096295pogb7g_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs) We have to stop Antifa and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.Antifa wants the literal end of America -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse – open violent anarchists who want to tear down civilization and remake it in their own twisted vision with no law and order.By any means necessary.**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. They did that with BLM. They’re doing it now against ICE.It's a sick strategy, but very smart – because so far, they've been successful.**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free.** Our politicians and media are treating this terrorist group like peaceful protestors!As we saw in Los Angeles earlier this summer, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continue to escape consequences.**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands – with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvgq49h1h9844snddkfis0s7upeib7mn14iv2220_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs) Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't.This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable. **[Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to help me get justice from Antifa?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4innb8mdvlbchru397m5prkdco1mgpmv927ed9g_rp22sh2s8i6eor4chj68pr1cdh2bs) **Please don't wait – if we don't fight back and win now, **these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America** , destroying everything and everyone in their path. Thank you in advance for your support.
---

---
**Andy Ngo**

|

Join us Thursday for Irvington's second most exciting October Event | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/andreahunley/events-for-democracy-october-november-18252858?e=d9ebccf591)

# IRVINGTON FOR DEMOCRACY
Dear Friends,
Everyone in Indianapolis knows that October is Irvington's month to shine. I am proud to represent the neighborhood, and am always glad to get in the spooky spirit of Halloween with them. However, this year our state is faced with something scarier than Irvington's usual friendly ghosts and ghouls: mid-decade gerrymandering. I have been fighting hard to protect our democracy against this power grab, and thanks to you, I hope to be able to continue doing this.

Irvington is much more than just the Halloween festival: it is one of the strongest, best organized communities in our city, and that community is ready to lead the fight for a stronger future for our state. This year, Ariel Ream and Marie Hitze have made sure that October in Irvington also means organizing for a stronger future for our democracy.

Join us at **Jockamo's Pizza, on Thursday, 10/23 from 6 to 8 pm** for pizza and politics. There you will be able to meet me and other Hoosiers passionate about making a change, and help contribute to my efforts to protect our communities. [RSVP here](https://andreahunley.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=fa1ad152de&e=d9ebccf591).

If you can't make it, or even if you can, check out our other events:
* I am hosting a **make and meet at Tuggle's Gifts & Goods to Sunday, 11/2 from 6:30 to 8 pm.** We will decorate tote bags with patches, pins, stencils and more, all while enjoying bubbly drinks, sweet treats, and great conversation. [Get tickets here](https://andreahunley.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=f7e6238083&e=d9ebccf591).

* I'll be hosting a **town hall, at the West Indianapolis Library on Saturday, 11/1 at 10 am**. As I am getting ready to return to the State House, I want to make sure that I am taking your concerns with me to make sure that I represent you as well as possible.

I hope to see you there soon, Andrea

# Wednesday, October 22, 2025
---|---

body:

| | |

| You're Invited!
---
| We're excited to invite you to the 2025 Campaign and Candidate Virtual Bootcamp Series, hosted in partnership with the Republican National Committee (RNC).
This series of training sessions are designed to equip you with the tools, strategies, and confidence to run a successful campaign and win. These trainings are designed for candidates running for office, campaign staff and volunteers who are involved or want to be involved in campaigns at any level, or those just wanting to learn the basics of running a political campaign. The [Virtual Bootcamp series](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULZ08yXoFj0KO7ArRneauEiZeCsFBQ69VoBmlj3-UewoGuuDptgg3WNmzrGcN2Rcz5hRlCG_UkUchVrlPy5O3p8_InB0Q3vB9sOb1grnojkVazPq480EhpYyzrmXUjx1Jp94kWD_GPN6IjtqlqPjHZHA0OnTL-CtpJfSA2TtomKSPn3ktKQIqw_zX5mKHww8A_B-Sz8vibg=&c=myo4BOFIEWV_YqziJo-EUbYgCiMDn_gY7sfkXW4pYAXcet5KUGGvDw==&ch=sJtxsXSbdtfgwsErFJpOfznYUJwAP-ZBFzLQw-xz-Y-MViE5fvvZ9Q==) will take place over four weeks. Each session will have its own registration link, so be sure to sign up for the ones you plan to attend:

October 23, 2025 at 6pm \- Training 1: Finance - Raising the Money
* Develop a finance plan, diversify revenue streams, host effective events, and learn techniques for asking for donations.
* Register Here: [https://secure.anedot.com/negop/virtual-bootcamp1](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULZ08yXoFj0KO7ArRneauEiZeCsFBQ69VoBmlj3-UewoGuuDptgg3fFj4M8TjZKLdlctUpDPKT52ZOjOIkI0chDkpkWEFrShSJ59DmWdE9VqTsaN-elNcu3XQ46f8Gvh5l3onnEeK1CFb8dsI_DjE5Awx8aghjOVBpFu1hjXQ6c6Y0BJXK4GXbJC_ljr7JiR&c=myo4BOFIEWV_YqziJo-EUbYgCiMDn_gY7sfkXW4pYAXcet5KUGGvDw==&ch=sJtxsXSbdtfgwsErFJpOfznYUJwAP-ZBFzLQw-xz-Y-MViE5fvvZ9Q==)

October 30, 2025 at 6pm - Training 2: Communications - The Messaging Workshop
* Master best practices, craft compelling campaign messages, understand earned vs. paid media, and implement rapid response tactics.
* Register Here:[ https://secure.anedot.com/negop/virtual-bootcamp-2](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULZ08yXoFj0KO7ArRneauEiZeCsFBQ69VoBmlj3-UewoGuuDptgg3fFj4M8TjZKLXnmIhDY-PMMFJHlBl9kiwOoXV64prm20mLpOYSYktl-TlokaXqpQoy5lvZWrsTy9jsmvNSjc1B7XUByOkVnoqcljulQFtEi9MUxOxoWoNgIaaEeF1rZnn9GGfGAGoowv&c=myo4BOFIEWV_YqziJo-EUbYgCiMDn_gY7sfkXW4pYAXcet5KUGGvDw==&ch=sJtxsXSbdtfgwsErFJpOfznYUJwAP-ZBFzLQw-xz-Y-MViE5fvvZ9Q==)

November 3, 2025 at 6pm \- Training 3: Data - Talking to the Right Voters
* Gain insights into RNC data, follow data best practices, use data for voter targeting, and receive data center training.
* Register Here: [https://secure.anedot.com/negop/virtual-bootcamp-3](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULZ08yXoFj0KO7ArRneauEiZeCsFBQ69VoBmlj3-UewoGuuDptgg3fFj4M8TjZKLTstLRa_5OgxCeiR0cz7DCC7MnSw6lbLj8mvjgvO17tnVBoMNS50A9m_KjSxQ3kZ7AZuUxXs6UGYHloD2ycWIIdPnKUE0mIYSDylm6nv0qAc9gw2H1s7yvuCKALzgmlLP&c=myo4BOFIEWV_YqziJo-EUbYgCiMDn_gY7sfkXW4pYAXcet5KUGGvDw==&ch=sJtxsXSbdtfgwsErFJpOfznYUJwAP-ZBFzLQw-xz-Y-MViE5fvvZ9Q==)

November 13, 2025 at 6pm - Training 4: Political - The Ground Game and Putting it All Together
* Build grassroots infrastructure, execute voter contact strategies, manage mail campaigns, implement absentee voting, early voting, and Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts to mobilize voters, along with election integrity.
* Register Here:[ https://secure.anedot.com/negop/virtual-bootcamp-4](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ULZ08yXoFj0KO7ArRneauEiZeCsFBQ69VoBmlj3-UewoGuuDptgg3fFj4M8TjZKL7K9Pdx7UPMexTQelbDsvm8rylmpNuk-knDcluVhfxTH6eCmxC6-Q4s2nD1fFwDs-ftrbw7BTaVrfNzkctlr5x7wD5COSsTuqQlh_gNRrKYv8Ud2IcBQiU9mQCr8fbFo7&c=myo4BOFIEWV_YqziJo-EUbYgCiMDn_gY7sfkXW4pYAXcet5KUGGvDw==&ch=sJtxsXSbdtfgwsErFJpOfznYUJwAP-ZBFzLQw-xz-Y-MViE5fvvZ9Q==)

If you want to win, skip the guesswork - this is where it starts. Training, tools, and the roadmap to victory.

body:

[](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyckcuO2jAYhZ_G2TnyJc5lkQVDCBuYVlMJlpbz-3dw5VzkGFDfvqKiLzDbT-cc6dO5nvXZ-ODn8dNM2EJ46rjpG4Z1wiH6eTRz8s6k5fd9Sx60YEJRzqgQeo3LtiIkrTLbqlpgU2bY8qrkXDKmRHZrlaqhUuC4sSBlXbmGAQwlc6xsxAAu8-1rkDMhOCtUwXJXN1w6V9eWD9YOkhTMBIwph2XeMD5M8g8MfsCY_jx9xByWKQvtLaV1I3JHRE9Eb2a0S8rfMcA5YcyXOBLRS1UOtWiQNmAdLUomaV1ZSRvlCtM4oyrriOzvadLbco-ARHYf3ZF-HS5ElC88ofX3icjucH4TMNNq_DgT2b1sWCWZ_uiOet_vTnr3efzxS38dLvrnju5P13cnAZHd_nSl__2z2Nr16UPwW1mRgo2T8eGfXfruK49W_A0AAP__gqiZXA)

My fellow concerned American, I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs. And unless we do something to stop them today, I won't be the last. **[I'm asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me bring Antifa and its members who assaulted me to justice.](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyckcuO2jAYhZ_G2TnyJc5lkQVDCBuYVlMJlpbz-3dw5VzkGFDfvqKiLzDbT-cc6dO5nvXZ-ODn8dNM2EJ46rjpG4Z1wiH6eTRz8s6k5fd9Sx60YEJRzqgQeo3LtiIkrTLbqlpgU2bY8qrkXDKmRHZrlaqhUuC4sSBlXbmGAQwlc6xsxAAu8-1rkDMhOCtUwXJXN1w6V9eWD9YOkhTMBIwph2XeMD5M8g8MfsCY_jx9xByWKQvtLaV1I3JHRE9Eb2a0S8rfMcA5YcyXOBLRS1UOtWiQNmAdLUomaV1ZSRvlCtM4oyrriOzvadLbco-ARHYf3ZF-HS5ElC88ofX3icjucH4TMNNq_DgT2b1sWCWZ_uiOet_vTnr3efzxS38dLvrnju5P13cnAZHd_nSl__2z2Nr16UPwW1mRgo2T8eGfXfruK49W_A0AAP__gqiZXA) ** **I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in Portland, Oregon during the summer of 2019.** This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc and violence before. I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist to document and report on their "protest." As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety. The mob was angry, and violence always follows Antifa. Most of them wore masks to prevent being identified when they commit crimes. Many had on helmets and carried riot gear. Some, I later learned, secretly had weapons like baseball bats, brass knuckles and even bricks. I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on. **People like you needed to know what was happening.** But I didn't go unnoticed for long. Somebody recognized me and bashed me on the back of my head in an ambush. "F*** you, Andy Ngo!" shouted voices around me. "Go home, fascist!" **Fists started flying at my face and head. Then came the projectiles.** Before I knew it, I was being repeatedly punched, kicked, and hit with objects. I tried to protect my head. I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger. The thugs robbed me of my camera so that I wouldn't have evidence of the assault. What they did to me is unacceptable and criminal. And now they're trying to do the same to other innocent Americans like you. That's why I sued members of the Rose City Antifa organization to bring them to justice and send the loud clear message that they are NOT above the law. Now I need your help to hold their feet to the fire and make sure justice is served. [**Will you donate $35 or more to help me hold Antifa accountable?**](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyckcuO2jAYhZ_G2TnyJc5lkQVDCBuYVlMJlpbz-3dw5VzkGFDfvqKiLzDbT-cc6dO5nvXZ-ODn8dNM2EJ46rjpG4Z1wiH6eTRz8s6k5fd9Sx60YEJRzqgQeo3LtiIkrTLbqlpgU2bY8qrkXDKmRHZrlaqhUuC4sSBlXbmGAQwlc6xsxAAu8-1rkDMhOCtUwXJXN1w6V9eWD9YOkhTMBIwph2XeMD5M8g8MfsCY_jx9xByWKQvtLaV1I3JHRE9Eb2a0S8rfMcA5YcyXOBLRS1UOtWiQNmAdLUomaV1ZSRvlCtM4oyrriOzvadLbco-ARHYf3ZF-HS5ElC88ofX3icjucH4TMNNq_DgT2b1sWCWZ_uiOet_vTnr3efzxS38dLvrnju5P13cnAZHd_nSl__2z2Nr16UPwW1mRgo2T8eGfXfruK49W_A0AAP__gqiZXA) This is bigger than me alone. After I got away from the mob, police finally showed up when I was in the hospital. But my attackers stole my evidence and nearly silenced me permanently with a traumatic brain injury. Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured part of the attack, clear as day. I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved. Wrong. To this day, six years later, the Portland Police have done nothing. **No charges. No arrests. No suspects questioned.** It's not much of a surprise, though. Radical politicians have long since bowed to the dangerous left-wing mobs that terrorize their streets. That's why the Center for American Liberty helped me file a lawsuit against my attackers. A judge ordered three of them to pay damages - but more than a year later and they have not paid a dime. So now the Center for American Liberty is helping me track them down and make them pay for nearly killing me and trampling upon the First Amendment. Unfortunately it's going to cost at least $20,000 to get justice. [**That's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my efforts to hold Antifa and its members accountable.**](https://email.alert.conservativelibertywire.com/c/eJyckcuO2jAYhZ_G2TnyJc5lkQVDCBuYVlMJlpbz-3dw5VzkGFDfvqKiLzDbT-cc6dO5nvXZ-ODn8dNM2EJ46rjpG4Z1wiH6eTRz8s6k5fd9Sx60YEJRzqgQeo3LtiIkrTLbqlpgU2bY8qrkXDKmRHZrlaqhUuC4sSBlXbmGAQwlc6xsxAAu8-1rkDMhOCtUwXJXN1w6V9eWD9YOkhTMBIwph2XeMD5M8g8MfsCY_jx9xByWKQvtLaV1I3JHRE9Eb2a0S8rfMcA5YcyXOBLRS1UOtWiQNmAdLUomaV1ZSRvlCtM4oyrriOzvadLbco-ARHYf3ZF-HS5ElC88ofX3icjucH4TMNNq_DgT2b1sWCWZ_uiOet_vTnr3efzxS38dLvrnju5P13cnAZHd_nSl__2z2Nr16UPwW1mRgo2T8eGfXfruK49W_A0AAP__gqiZXA) We have to stop Antifa and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family. Antifa wants the literal end of America -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse - open violent anarchists who want to tear down civilization and remake it in their own twisted vision with no law and order. By any means necessary. **_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. ## Austin Homeless Camps Cleared
Gov. Greg Abbott directed the Texas Department of Public Safety to lead an effort to [clear homeless encampments](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOmzAURb_GbEb2A0MyeOjClq4d0QM_g1VjI_wSkr-viNT-QOcrHd1zfj3GB4YY0vITN7L89nlMdJZIzHSMa94oUikzbnuZI-FBrjAyjaDASK0kwOgwxM_YVs5Oyt11RVb3ndaNut26arWmn_vGODTaNxqg8-6ue0-optb3U0tVsBdMKwCtlYa2vvtmUgZ7473pYDaiVeQC56PmlZjeWHz85Bcd9Zy3KtqVeS-i-SFgEDCc51n_fmO6RgHDZSNgiHnGKGDAZ-GQBAxLfkmcpswsXTho5iLdXuTXTi5PPJzkLC_nJJ-7_FtCUrpibJS4yJDkP151WLefIcZQul60atkwxO9B_r-sLwt_AgAA___fdY9g) in Austin. name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: What’s a black-footed ferret?
body:
These prairie icons have a chance to make a comeback. Read on to find out how!

These prairie icons have a chance to make a comeback. Read on to find out how!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4117619/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/4117620/38SyG9Xl)

Meet your prairie BFF!

What’s a black-footed ferret?

Beneath the vast, windswept American prairie, tiny hunters sleep through the day. They emerge by nightfall, first as a pair of round ears and dark-masked eyes, followed by a long body and fluffy tail – the unmistakable markers of black-footed ferrets! Once thought extinct in the wild, these elusive grassland critters have begun to make a comeback.

Where can they be found?

A long time ago, thousands of these ferrets ranged from Canada to Mexico. Prairie dogs are their primary prey, so black-footed ferrets have always gone where the prairie dogs are. Sadly, in the past 150 years we have lost 97% of prairie dogs within their historic range, with negative impacts for all prairie wildlife. Now only a few hundred black-footed ferrets remain.

So what’s been happening?

Since black-footed ferrets were rediscovered on a Wyoming ranch in 1981, conservationists have worked hard to pave their way for their return to the prairie! The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service led a captive breeding and release program to give ferrets a fighting chance. Still, challenges remain, especially as important wildlife recovery programs have been jeopardized.

How can I help?

Defenders is a key player in the effort to save black-footed ferrets and other prairie wildlife. We work with land management agencies, nonprofits and landowners to maintain and expand prairie dog habitat on active ferret recovery sites. With your support, we’ll keep working to return ferrets in full force!

Learn more about ferrets and other prairie wildlife! (https://support.defenders.org/s/4117621/38SyG9Xl)

Peter, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, _" You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois."_ So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving.
| [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=6ab853af47524dcb982d98750467eafb&_e=tq_w-pOo3bLr6UEOMKLUOoITrYqjW1XWYbwkQaaOkLEAMVxrLfZhB7_DyqYFddtb9vRV_QD8JnZuh-_Cs8dGGDINdwKAGmRQVJ7GKl_FJaNJETNUNIQOAOLoX9dEDHS1PUhliK3EtVpJY22TXRtLsNceszXqkqYskIkASByX4HHbG2Nxo_tf4hgxWu6DsIftyc-x7OP_hGm9xAcmo1Uhscxyuat17_Tx-AP__KXVIO4OWhyYpMzW5pviFlx_cliWsEjljfju3roBQ4Hf4PvMbg0cgoNJK9eQhufMVK73Pe0RQxRfUbi9KSBNiR4EUr35KPylvWoyIRHPDcFyYZpaI5cZHZIY9kzonisDNnC2NuxygYwdf3uSO5n6FoKIpLg-BtUVbQIumsR1_3q4an5wO0_jmSfe5oayegl9vtTcA0exwTL7o5o82SwcqS2Pwja5nRaTR_I9fD7v0C-uuv4MEeobZcwWDWgOchllHcmu7xDj2pEQB5EcSUbC_gfJv3agau0qZ5faJYhfM_w9vRfRskPOXNZRTc7tfA6-slYMUmXr2hOL7s7h-Til0tkWJql6Nb3tF9TXeqUotySpmZw4E8-fqdincppzxJPXgPk5u5qaInej2cQn9EDuukmeAxwhPv-9c2JZR5VHqj9IN0pIxJBrWtjZnnOWu4N4UguXLyGzmcvlLyXzopUYK7p59qpNfT5Ql0TTqkms1lFNekURJw%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. _
Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... _I knew._ Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. **Faith, family, freedom** -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? _He did it._ He didn't just build a brand... _He built a machine._ First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it _from the start._ Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together.
| [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=6ab853af47524dcb982d98750467eafb&_e=tq_w-pOo3bLr6UEOMKLUOoITrYqjW1XWYbwkQaaOkLEAMVxrLfZhB7_DyqYFddtb9vRV_QD8JnZuh-_Cs8dGGDINdwKAGmRQVJ7GKl_FJaNJETNUNIQOAOLoX9dEDHS1PUhliK3EtVpJY22TXRtLsNceszXqkqYskIkASByX4HHbG2Nxo_tf4hgxWu6DsIftyc-x7OP_hGm9xAcmo1Uhscxyuat17_Tx-AP__KXVIO4OWhyYpMzW5pviFlx_cliWcLTsDBgeEKocVQCNH5H2U6Vyr7MCcvVTNduV6y_L5PyQPEYU5vYyGjtnBT1bHoHM4QHn6QCEVHfejlOUHXaP1hiVOPYE3qkuSpHpphj2LNWKXxoQftjGSKRK7VOw1W-O5hSrV64Nv2tT6MMpREkQ2Bb4CFkNRTpWzEGlfM109LQP9323si4iL-IxKmJm_4gWyHfhdOoKEzQ35Ieve9RChezpV6LuB4wN7GQMOcVAgNejMpIgSjJH-PEo4ojrJ-v1XsD8iQ8Qln9eCj1FmI24lVT1V5R1nRH_i9uyLuWFGDjFxJYrh-sgZCuDyi31DNYvrHekb6MsUa7zJu8Mg0zH4Ow6BHJOM0qI47oLjMMV6qwII1_TS1nlzBX1VoVQ7T5-1ln45gMk6Bxyh24vMQAU6lqqQQQGyDH8PJ7YqFfEwADUQT1eMoGR_dc08lK99bcJMhqMq9LQw-a1r7FJi5OxhQ%3D%3D)
---
We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. **And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. ** We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- _and it delivered real results._ 10 for 10. **In every single state we operated in... Trump won.** In Arizona _alone,_ we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. _In Wisconsin?_ 60,000+. _In Nevada?_ 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. _In Michigan?_ 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... _We made history. _
| [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=6ab853af47524dcb982d98750467eafb&_e=tq_w-pOo3bLr6UEOMKLUOoITrYqjW1XWYbwkQaaOkLEAMVxrLfZhB7_DyqYFddtb9vRV_QD8JnZuh-_Cs8dGGDINdwKAGmRQVJ7GKl_FJaNJETNUNIQOAOLoX9dEDHS1PUhliK3EtVpJY22TXRtLsNceszXqkqYskIkASByX4HHbG2Nxo_tf4hgxWu6DsIftyc-x7OP_hGm9xAcmo1Uhscxyuat17_Tx-AP__KXVIO4OWhyYpMzW5pviFlx_cliWzyFd8dZaMT6mUOHG9tfmpmHlEOJT9HsBuN8GF-vf4FhAup3OLmKbwuc0T1mPX0v1c5XgY5KMm9Osci778_3kJXc0b6tVK6oNkZ7Z5EnCI2W9z3GZgHdp3mD8LaGS-MIgtFB_dqdNNZfEhE_gWO5ItZWeTraJMPLJMOKVrjRJ47HrSsk9xg5DaJqqOWLWoh-y8cG_GP9b_CVTouqXHAge7cnlqAfvAOe9HyNfO__OzDHVURcwSH-poz44CUQ6-WlXEn1jO1PG2WVu3gEFi_e7jVrQi0CluXGj3axM3_jQoCp3x7yCAYPS4E06i5j_B-vZ7zyrCGWVnKSbCgBygTksqywtpI8czU1RzLgO3FexR0JZayWEVujK1XyWxSgQLLHDNx7f_RyvIDqyU_6FwfaQrTj_-i2MOzkScO3VvHucAGXjmTSL4GwJzlWpw_b1BOb7QDLqX07t_7Cr41Z5wUn5MQ%3D%3D)
---
_**Above:** Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. _
Peter, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. _Because Charlie never stopped. _ He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? **We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- ****_and make it stronger than ever._** Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- _we must turn it into action._ He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: _" What are we building next?"_ **Well, Peter, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time.**
| [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=6ab853af47524dcb982d98750467eafb&_e=tq_w-pOo3bLr6UEOMKLUOoITrYqjW1XWYbwkQaaOkLEAMVxrLfZhB7_DyqYFddtb9vRV_QD8JnZuh-_Cs8dGGDINdwKAGmRQVJ7GKl_FJaNJETNUNIQOAOLoX9dEDHS1PUhliK3EtVpJY22TXRtLsNceszXqkqYskIkASByX4HHbG2Nxo_tf4hgxWu6DsIftyc-x7OP_hGm9xAcmo1Uhscxyuat17_Tx-AP__KXVIO4OWhyYpMzW5pviFlx_cliWJAG7B4nvzrNXN-N7SIgJFbcmG_nm375Kh9i7l4YduUikKSLvDj2lKFi0VJEb-XifWTpXJHu3xRA4XtF-DULW9szMO6TAPu5CCy16kWLs7YFCD6iHMpKwd0v04g3ew3Qwk-h82x2PxKDxJKPNaNnV4e8CgCt3abelEUOXSFLP9xJWdU23NZqDQKB1AbVKUT8RV2FHBhiBLUwW5YdDu_I7MT1lS2xT16eF2Th1mF1N5OyJjhSQFG1ZJRpWxySOakLdzkwl4qwrxNiDjPfEvWnc7jQ31_2BZZhgHf1PYY01KA4hsyTA_AFHQdhRFnnQ7RZqEA3uoGRlYdnRw-4iQ10bYwVjnPcP1VE4GL1rMscspcytuJ2benO_NuSOC3vdODPZ8RPiAHIgfRwqWK8C3TvLeTAqWBEHmI8P3SM24PgtuzOO8yxrNt3P9CDY1MsuxfXrwLFqnc-FGc4guSSZXDo8Dw%3D%3D)
---
**But it doesn 't happen without you.** _So, here 's my ask..._ Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work.
**For Charlie.** **God Bless,** **Tyler Bowyer**
Chief Operating Officer

clean_body: Faith. Family. Freedom. And a whole lot of grit. A tribute to Charlie & Turning Point Action—see how to help and double your impact today. | | Peter, When I heard of Charlie Kirk, he wasn't famous. He wasn't filling arenas. He wasn't a household name. A few people told me, " You've gotta meet this guy -- he's doing something big out in Illinois." So I went. Charlie was running Turning Point from a modest office in the Chicago suburbs -- surviving on coffee and pure belief that America was still worth saving. | Above: The original Turning Point HQ in Lemont, Illinois. This is where it all began -- just Charlie, a vision, and a mission that changed everything. Back then, we were both organizing young conservatives, both dreaming about how to win back the culture. But when I first sat down with Charlie... I knew. Charlie was the visionary. He had the plan. And I HAD to be part of it. I jumped in and never looked back. From that moment on, I was there for all of it. The early conferences and campuses. The road trips. The rallies. The fights. In those days, our team didn't have much. But what we had was conviction -- and that was more than enough. Because we believed in something BIG. Something real. Something urgent. Faith, family, freedom -- and the absolute grit to go build something that could save this country. And Charlie? He did it. He didn't just build a brand... He built a machine. First, Charlie built a movement that changed the hearts and minds of an entire generation -- a seismic shift that flipped the narrative that young people belonged to the Left. Then, he built Turning Point Action to become the grassroots force the Left never saw coming... and beat them at their own game. And, I hitched my wagon to it from the start. Charlie and I weren't just friends... We were brothers in the fight. We did everything together. | We strategized over midnight texts... battled together through COVID, the 2020 Election, and every crisis they threw at us... We created AmericaFest from scratch... launched Turning Point Action to go on offense -- in the very states the GOP had given up on. And we rallied a grassroots army that put President Donald J. Trump back in the White House in 2024. We didn't just talk about chasing ballots... Turning Point Action built the first full-scale, professional ballot-chasing operation on the Right -- and it delivered real results. 10 for 10. In every single state we operated in... Trump won. In Arizona alone, we chased over 205,000 low-propensity conservative votes -- well beyond the margin of victory. In Wisconsin? 60,000+. In Nevada? 6,000+ -- and we won back a district we hadn't carried in 20 years. In Michigan? 14,000+ votes helped us flip a U.S. House seat and take the state house majority. We didn't just make noise... We made history. | Above: Election Night 2024. Our biggest win yet. That's me on the left -- still fighting beside Charlie, just like we always did. Peter, I watched Charlie pour everything into this mission. He lived on the road 300+ days a year. We never stopped. Because Charlie never stopped. He didn't build all of this for clout or clicks... Instead, he did it for this country. For all of us. For every parent who feels like they're losing their kid to the Left... For every student who's afraid to speak up... For every American who still believes in this country... Charlie built this movement and this machine for them. For you. And now? After he gave everything for that mission? We have to carry the torch. We have to keep the machine running -- and make it stronger than ever. Everything we've felt since the day we lost Charlie -- we must turn it into action. He used to ask me (and everyone else at Turning Point) all the time: " What are we building next?" Well, Peter, here 's the answer: We're building the next generation of grassroots power -- one voter, one precinct, one act of courage at a time. | But it doesn 't happen without you. So, here 's my ask... Go to church for Charlie. Start a family for Charlie. Join a chapter or coalition for Charlie. Register to vote for Charlie. Chase votes for Charlie. Run for office for Charlie. Commit to WIN. Commit to FIGHT. Commit to FINISH what he started. That's what Charlie would've wanted. I'm not stopping until we save our country. I'm all in -- and if you're reading this, I'm betting that you are, too. If so, I'm honored to fight alongside you. And if you've already been with us for a while -- thank you. Now, let's get to work. For Charlie. God Bless, Tyler Bowyer Chief Operating Officer Turning Point Action P.S. I would give anything to have Charlie back. But he left us with something powerful -- a machine that works... a machine that's proven and battle-tested. Now it's time to run it -- and run it like never before. Bigger. Bolder. More battlegrounds. More victories. Because right now, thanks to a generous supporter of Turning Point Action, your gift will be matched dollar-for-dollar -- up to $500,000, through October 31. That means, with your gift today: ✅ 2X the activists trained ✅ 2X the voters registered ✅ 2X the pressure on weak-kneed politicians ✅ 2X the ballot-chasing operations ✅ 2X the grassroots strength the Left can't stop We don't need to reinvent anything. Charlie already drew the blueprint and turned the key. So, if you've been wondering how to help... If you've been asking " what now?" Then, Peter, this is your moment to step in, fuel the fight, and take Charlie 's vision to the next level. Let's turn this energy -- this momentum -- into action. Mississippi has chased "economic development" longer than most states. Since the 1930s, our main tactic has been to lure outside companies with tax breaks, special deals, and public money. The targets changed--factories, shipyards, auto plants--but the approach stayed the same: politicians pick winners, taxpayers carry the risk, and the promised jobs often fall short.
The record tells a plain story. Big incentive packages make for great ribbon-cuttings, but they rarely lift the whole economy. They tilt the field toward a few large firms and away from the family businesses that create most new jobs. They also drain the treasury. When leaders hand out credits and tax breaks to a handful of companies, everyone else pays more--or local services get cut to make up the difference. Clawbacks sound tough, but they recover little and arrive long after the headlines fade.
There is a better path, and it is boring on purpose: clear rules that apply to everyone. States with low, simple taxes--broad base, modest rates, few exemptions--attract investment without writing checks. When we cut needless licenses and paperwork, more Mississippians can work, start side gigs, and grow into employers. When we protect property rights and due process--tight limits on civil asset forfeiture, predictable enforcement--capital stays put and new capital shows up. When parents can choose schools, skills rise where people live, not just where a corporation parks a plant.
Our habit of one-off deals also warps local politics. City halls become gatekeepers of "opportunity." Companies learn that lobbying can beat competing. The codebook swells with exceptions and carve-outs. Meanwhile, the general business climate gets harder for the folks who don't have lobbyists. That's not conservative; it's favoritism. Pro-business shouldn't mean pro-favor. It should mean pro-market--one set of rules, fairly enforced.
Watch where people move. Families move toward places where work is open, rules are stable, and the tax bite is predictable. Entrepreneurs start where they're trusted to try, fail, and try again without asking permission from a board or chasing a grant. That's the kind of growth that compounds: a thousand small decisions to invest, hire, and build--made every day by people who know the rules won't change with the next press conference.
So what should Mississippi do?
* **End targeted giveaways.** If a zero tax bill is "needed" for one firm, lower rates for everyone instead.
* **Simplify the tax code.** Fewer credits and carve-outs; broader base and lower rates.
* **Cut red tape and shrink licensing.** Protect health and safety, not incumbents.
* **Strengthen property rights.** Tighten forfeiture and keep enforcement even-handed.
* **Expand school choice.** Grow talent at home so employers don't have to import it.

Mississippi doesn't need a bigger checkbook. It needs a better rulebook. When the state tries to act like a banker, we gamble with other people's money and lose leverage. When the state acts like an umpire--neutral, limited, predictable--we invite real prosperity: free people starting businesses, hiring neighbors, and keeping more of what they earn. That's how a poor state gets rich--and stays that way.

**Rich Lowrie** is an economist, strategist, and principled voice for restoring American prosperity through free-market innovation and moral clarity. As **Principal & Chief Investment Officer at Park Edge Capital**, Rich brings more than three decades of experience guiding investors and policymakers through the intersection of finance, policy, and human purpose.
**[GET YOUR TICKET TODAY.](https://substack.com/redirect/8d44536f-5291-4899-9348-8d6fccff1de2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d94f132-e978-48ae-a541-18df999d8c33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Rich has advised presidential and Senate campaigns--including serving as Senior Economic Advisor to Herman Cain, where he co-authored the landmark _9-9-9 Plan_. He later advised both Vivek Ramaswamy's presidential campaign and Kathy Barnette's Senate run, helping articulate an economic vision rooted not in redistribution but in renewal--one that rewards work, innovation, and responsibility.
At **[Seed& Roots 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/2d94f132-e978-48ae-a541-18df999d8c33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[,](https://substack.com/redirect/2d94f132-e978-48ae-a541-18df999d8c33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Rich will explore how wealth creation and moral conviction can--and must--coexist. He'll unpack why freedom in markets depends on virtue in people, and how ordinary Americans can reclaim control of their economic future in an age of centralization and cultural decay.
**[CLICK HERE TO PURCHASE YOUR TICKET](https://substack.com/redirect/8d44536f-5291-4899-9348-8d6fccff1de2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
🗓 **Saturday, October 25, 2025**
📍 **Philadelphia, PA | Independence Visitor Center**
⏰ **9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Doors open at 8:30 AM)**
* * *
### ⚙️ **Why Does It Matter**
Because economics is never just about numbers--it's about _dignity_. When citizens lose ownership over their labor, savings, and enterprise, they lose agency over their lives. Rich's message is clear: prosperity without principle collapses, but when moral truth guides economic freedom, both people and nations flourish.
Come. Learn. Ask questions. Prepare.

Is AI a bubble? I've been seeing that question a lot lately. From Andrew Ross Sorkin to Derek Thompson to Hank Green, everyone seems to be engaging on this topic. Sorkin is likening this period to that before the crash of 1929, which is the subject of his well-researched new book.
I'm a distinct figure to be evaluating this given that I literally wrote a book, "[The War on Normal People](https://substack.com/redirect/4fcd3dc6-4c42-416e-a3fe-3c90ad163389?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," about how AI was/is going to replace millions of workers and ran for President on this very case. So you'd think that if anyone thought AI was indeed going to fundamentally change the nature of work, it would be me.
And yet.
The numbers are staggering. $300 billion is being spent on data centers every 10 months. AI companies have accounted for 70% of the stock market's gains this year. Without data centers, GDP growth was only .1% in the first half of 2025. Every time a company says it's investing billions in AI, investors cheer and bid up its stock.
Total AI revenue this year will be about $60 billion - if I told you I'd pay you $60 this year would you spend $300 - $400 a year trying to improve your product with no end in sight? Yes if you expected the revenue to go up 10 - 20x VERY quickly. In many ways, the question is how much revenue will show up and when.
Are you a user of AI tools? And how much would you pay? The scale of investment might not make sense given that a Chinese model - think DeepSeek - could undercut the pricing of what a lot of individuals or companies pay even if it's somewhat less reliable or advanced. You also have multiple major U.S. companies that will have to compete somewhat on price.
One red flag to many observers is how much money seems to be passing between the major players, as Nvidia is financing purchases of its own chips from various companies. Oracle - a massive firm - said it would finance investments in AI with debt because the sums were too big to do so out of ordinary cash flow. This graphic from Bloomberg shows how incestuous the corporate relationships are.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ccd133a5-8e8e-4098-8b90-9d28b2bbead3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The financing of purchases was known as 'roundtripping' during the dot-com and telecom boom of 1999, when companies regularly gave customers money to make big orders. Company A gives Company B money to buy things from Company A, sometimes through Company C. It makes an industry look a whole lot more robust than it actually is.
When I was talking to investors about [Noble Mobile](https://substack.com/redirect/06171715-085a-4e13-a407-ff6b5388748f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of them said to me, "Andrew, if you start something with AI in the name, we'll cut you a check right now." That's a sign of where we are.
I'm old enough to remember the Internet boom of the late 90s and the crash of 2000. Anything with ".com" in its stock name shot up to astronomical heights, with "Pets.com" being one of the emblems of the age. AOL bought Time Warner, as the Internet figuratively swallowed old media. Then, the air came out of the bubble and stocks touching the Internet collapsed 80% or more. A lot of the companies simply disappeared.
I was a 25-year-old wannabe entrepreneur at the time; we subleased space from a company called "Silicon Alley Recruiters" that itself had gone down from 100 employees to 1 person turning off the lights. I attended elaborate launch parties as a random kid eating the food only to see the same company sell itself off for parts or shut down a few years later.
But here's the thing; all the hype did come to pass a number of years later. The Internet DID change everything. Amazon grew beyond books to, well, everything and is now a multi-trillion dollar company.
I talk to CEOs who are indeed replacing customer service departments with AI, and as a customer the bots are getting better and faster. Friends who are partners at law firms are saying to me, "Why are we going to spend 3 years trying to train an associate to effectively draft and review contracts when an AI can already do it faster?" Entry-level white collars jobs are [evaporating](https://substack.com/redirect/a428f6c9-92c6-4179-9af7-4b88221c3d43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Designers and composers can see the writing on the wall clear as day. Sure the work may need a reviewer or editor, but that still might save you 90% of the time. I rode in a Waymo multiple times and would do it again. This stuff is real.
Two things can be true at the same time: hype has inflated the valuation of AI-related companies beyond all sense of current economic reality AND AI is upending labor markets as we speak and will transform the way we work, learn, think, innovate and operate.
Is AI a bubble? In terms of the valuations of the companies and the amount that is currently being invested in its development being profitable in a reasonable time frame - almost certainly yes. In terms of the impact it will ultimately have on all of us - probably not.

Right-wing megadonor **Jeff Yass** , Pennsylvania’s richest man, is pouring money into this election to flip the PA Supreme Court to Republican control. And he’s doing it by spreading lies.
Yass’s PAC and their affiliated organizations have spent millions on misleading ads designed to confuse and mislead voters into voting against their interests.
But don’t take our word for it. Yass’s lies have been so blatant that even news outlets have called out these attacks as “misleading.”

We can’t let billionaires like Yass take control of our courts and tip the scales of justice in their favor.
Every 10 years, Pennsylvania voters decide whether to keep our state Supreme Court justices — and this year, three justices who’ve defended our rights time and again are up for retention.
One PA, along with partners like the Pennsylvania Working Families Party, are organizing across the state to cut through Yass’s lies and make sure voters know the truth — but we can’t do it without your support.
_**[Can you donate today to fund our voter outreach and organizing work in this critical election??](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117743134/577511604/720563957?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20251022_fr_scopa_team_oc_act_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vQ1BELzEvMTEzNTk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0Yzc4YzkyLTQxYWYtZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=RXc8sXYYpo9RUhq0NuZ3c-tBlb8nBo_uhVGunsdqMw0=)**_
If you’re unable to donate, **vote YES to retain the three Pennsylvania Supreme Court justices on November 4th.**
Together, we can defend our courts, protect our rights, and show billionaires like Yass that Pennsylvania’s future belongs to the people — not their money.
In solidarity,
Jeffrey Lichtenstein

---
| |

I'm thrilled to invite you to a special, intimate fundraising concert on **Saturday, November 1st** , with rising country music star **Trey Taylor!**
---
| |
**Trey Taylor's reached out to us - i** nspired by our fight to bring a new generation of leadership to Washington, Trey has generously offered to perform an intimate fundraising concert right here in Central Florida on **Saturday, November 1st**.

He has been an outspoken critic of the inhumane treatment of migrants and the way the billionaire class targets working-class communities, and he sees this race as a place where moral clarity can make a national impact.
---
| |

**For those who don't know him, Trey's story is incredible.** Discovered at 16 by Dolly Parton's longtime producer, he is the youngest African-American artist ever signed to a Nashville country music deal. Inspired by Dolly's own philanthropy, Trey has made it his mission to support leaders across the country who are fighting for justice and real results. He has been an outspoken critic of the way the billionaire class targets working-class communities, and he sees this race as a place where moral clarity can make a national impact.
---
| |

**This is a unique opportunity to hear his incredible music up close and support our people-powered movement. Every dollar raised goes directly to funding the outreach and field operations we need to take on one of the most corrupt incumbents in the country.**
---

| Peter,
This is the message we hoped we wouldn't have to send--we're now officially behind budget heading into the final stretch before Pennsylvania votes in their critical November 2025 Supreme Court Election.
If we don't close this gap immediately, we risk running out of resources at the exact moment the far-right is unloading a tidal wave of dark-money ads to steal the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.

| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001x7n1ftOtLYyFxpq2bY_fWgB1RetmJOGMWpYODemedEenie6dkaImrQI88uBnxmQ9tAmGYXpgjNoe9NxCO3N0-aa3yyYvTrXta8qtXJKjmKPL0XXYTOLgd18fAf5fu8_Fank5F6PeH9vaVNNxTCN-KYx-UB5U7FZr1bYiJuYZx7vCQIlCbRLp3qy4dzoZ5x5BQdM8FaI5iiGZgNK95fs5sfKg3PMqPVXsRX37aoGOyck=&c=Gn5BhcGdg9EbeWUNsY30rHTdD9TF8zIOnRSNxwaZmWZMBdgAb14JWA==&ch=Y3D-_tFhrpNtNIGfhm-LuTECXlcYRICW6jtKR4KcnIiwokTBrVfNFw==)

| | | | There is no worse time to fall short than right now.
The truth:
Our rapid-response programs were built assuming we'd keep pace with their spending. We didn't. And with just 13 days left until the November elections, we are dangerously close to scaling back -- just as right-wing spending surges.

body:
Gaudy renovations during a shutdown. We’re fighting for working families.
| | | | Can't see this email? [View in Your Browser](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K85ZFN05GZ80A5K2909AZESY_0)

---
| | | | Dear Peter, Donald Trump built his political brand railing against “wasteful government spending.” He sold voters on the myth of his business savvy. But we’ve seen the truth under the lid of the gold-plated toilet—Trump is full of it. He has always been more interested in serving his own interest than those of the American people.
Now, while families across Tennessee are struggling with rising costs, Trump is spending taxpayer money like one of his billionaire pals and bragging about Oval Office renovations—complete with 24-karat gold accents—on social media. (Who knows if he is even telling the truth about whether it’s real gold or spray paint?) This ridiculousness comes after he paved over the historic Rose Garden and pushes forward with a $200 million White House ballroom project... all while the government is shut down and he argues that furloughed federal workers shouldn’t receive backpay.
Let’s be clear: this is not leadership. This is vanity. This is a man who is completely detached from reality and void of empathy.
We can’t let this corrupt authoritarian, to whom Marsha, Hagerty and Lee bow down, continue to destroy our country from within the White House. Tennessee families deserve leaders who care about them more than gaudy renovations and disco balls.
If you’re fed up with the corruption and cruelty, chip in whatever you can. Every dollar helps us organize, mobilize, and beat corrupt politicians dismantling our democracy.

We're living in the midst of difficult and divisive times. The godless, secular society that's been pushed on us for decades has failed us. It's time to honor the values that make America strong and made America great. That’s why I just introduced the _In God We Trust Act_ —legislation that would require the national motto to be displayed on every federal building in the United States. During the rise of the godless communism of the 1950s, President Dwight Eisenhower fought to enshrine "In God We Trust” as America's national motto, explaining, “ _In this way we are reaffirming the transcendence of religious faith in America’s heritage and future; in this way we shall constantly strengthen those spiritual weapons which forever will be our country’s most powerful resource in peace and war.” _Those are words to live by today! But somewhere along the way, Washington forgot. Instead of honoring faith and freedom, federal buildings are covered in woke propaganda. That needs to change.

clean_body: We need your input.| | | | | | | Peter, We're living in the midst of difficult and divisive times. The godless, secular society that's been pushed on us for decades has failed us. It's time to honor the values that make America strong and made America great. That’s why I just introduced the In God We Trust Act —legislation that would require the national motto to be displayed on every federal building in the United States. During the rise of the godless communism of the 1950s, President Dwight Eisenhower fought to enshrine "In God We Trust” as America's national motto, explaining, “ In this way we are reaffirming the transcendence of religious faith in America’s heritage and future; in this way we shall constantly strengthen those spiritual weapons which forever will be our country’s most powerful resource in peace and war.” Those are words to live by today! But somewhere along the way, Washington forgot. Instead of honoring faith and freedom, federal buildings are covered in woke propaganda. That needs to change. | | | | | | As America prepares to celebrate its 250th birthday, it’s time to restore faith to its rightful place in the halls of government. I told you what I believe—but I want to hear from you. In Liberty, Josh Hawley | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Josh Hawley Victory Committee | | | | | | | | |

| | | | | When you mess up, you make up, but you **NEVER GIVE UP.**

I arrived in Florida at 17 years old on a Greyhound bus, with a trunk full of clothes and a dream.

In Florida, I found God.
In Florida, I turned my life around.
In Florida, I became a working professional.
In Florida, I became a family man.
In Florida, I found my voice.

I've lived the American Dream in Florida, and I'm fighting to ensure _**[EVERY FLORIDIAN](http://click.info.byron-donalds.com/?qs=5e2b4b71d54453910d9c5a8a5afd14fb9d108ea3ff1c46c31fd97dc9ae82b5a3d79615ae8c73d9bbe6e683c3d101f26c80d1a9c79b4358e4c4df85e2e892f9d3 "EVERY FLORIDIAN")**_ gets that same shot.

But the Democrats' fundraising hand-over-fist to see Florida flip **BLUE** couldn't care less that I want to make America GREAT Again for everyone.

Because ever since Trump endorsed my race, the attacks against me have been relentless:

They'll get up in my face on the Fake News and House Floor screaming "fascist!" just because I'm Trump's _**[STRONGEST](http://click.info.byron-donalds.com/?qs=5e2b4b71d5445391f7f0a23746762644c82ddda7eb45b98afb9272e1964bed1dc5f2980ae2e4772fcf6d5740b9f4e60cba303cd492c3d408f4dbc1c803e935df "STRONGEST")**_ ally in Florida.

Their smears don't faze me, but what has my attention is the **MILLIONS** of dollars they want to spend against me to put Florida back in the **BLUE** column.

They want me to give up. They want Trump to give up. They want the MAGA Movement to give up.

_**If we let the Democrats take control of Florida, they 'll undo all the great policies that have turned Florida RED!**_

So, can I count on you to help me out and chip in whatever you can to show the Democrats plotting against me that MAGA will not submit?

Right now, my grassroots team is on the ground chasing mail-in ballots and preparing to launch our massive get out the vote program to **FLIP New Jersey** **from Blue to RED** this November, and we’re having great success.
[SPONSOR A BALLOT CHASER](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bnjE/?__vbtrk=MzI4MzI3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI4MzI3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)

We truly don’t have a moment to waste... mail-in voting is well underway, in-person Early Voting begins on October 25th, and Election Day is November 4th.

| | I'm still on the Senate floor — **_15 hours in_** — ringing the alarm bells about Trump's growing authoritarianism. Americans are standing up because the President is not a king, the law is not a suggestion, and the Constitution is not optional. But Donald Trump is attacking the free press, deploying the military against peaceful protesters, defying court orders, and weaponizing federal agencies to punish his enemies. | | Peter, As Lieutenant Governor and the wife of a soybean farmer, I see firsthand how **bad policies from Biden's term hurt the very people who feed this nation**.

Under Joe Biden, the U.S. went from exporting 400 million metric tons of used cooking oil to importing 1.2 Billion, mostly from China, in just two years. That’s not energy independence. That’s economic dependence on the Chinese Communist Party.

**President Trump is right.**

China’s refusal to buy American soybeans is an economically hostile act. It’s time we invest in our own farmers, strengthen biodiesel production, and stop paying China for what we can grow right here in Arkansas.

I recently joined Fox Business and RFD-TV to talk about how these policies are hurting Arkansas farmers and what we can do to fight back.

Illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios
We're now 22 days into the federal shutdown, officially [the second-longest shutdown in U.S. history](https://substack.com/redirect/20b37e4a-b58e-41de-a4ba-02f7e3f47b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). After months of inaction, it's been three weeks of gridlock, political theater, and finger-pointing, leaving already shorthanded federal prison guards, air traffic controllers, and hundreds of thousands of federal workers without pay, all while Congress & White House personnel still collect theirs.
This shutdown isn't just about one spending bill. It's the product of a long-simmering breakdown in trust between the parties. Republicans want a leaner government while the president is asserting powers traditionally and constitutionally reserved for Congress - including unilaterally imposing new tariffs, authorizing extrajudicial strikes off the coast of Venezuela, and deploying the National Guard to states without their governors' consent. Even the "Gang of Eight," the top congressional leaders from both parties who are typically briefed on the most sensitive national-security issues, have been left in the dark.

## **This shutdown is different.**
For the first time, a sitting president is using the lapse in funding not simply as leverage, but as a weapon to _reshape the federal government itself._
As _[The Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/8b023cd2-5851-4529-9431-d95268adcc2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ reported, after firing tens of thousands in the first few months in office, President Trump and his budget director, Russell Vough,t have recently **laid off more than 4,000 federal workers** across eight agencies, canceled infrastructure and clean-energy projects in Democratic districts, and moved to redirect billions in "unobligated" Pentagon funds to pay troops -- all without congressional approval.
The White House has also floated the idea that furloughed workers might not receive back pay despite a 2019 law guaranteeing it.
Here's a look at the [ramifications](https://substack.com/redirect/16c73836-f604-4f81-9e3d-5b7552a6fa11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
* **Hundreds of thousands of federal workers** are furloughed.
* **Thousands more have been fired outright** as part of Trump's government "purge."
* **Specialists overseeing the U.S. nuclear stockpile** have been told to go home.
* **Air traffic control shortages** are already causing travel chaos, with warnings that Thanksgiving could be a logistical nightmare.
* And **42 million Americans** relying on food assistance (SNAP) could lose it next month if the government remains closed.

But beneath the economic pain and political noise lies the real reason Washington can't agree: a power struggle over authority.
President Trump wants to permanently expand executive power through a little-used provision of the [1974 Impoundment Control Act](https://substack.com/redirect/a299cd8e-8d91-4347-aa87-38dfef337377?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to propose the cancellation of spending Congress has already approved, reviving a process known as "rescissions."
Democrats are asking for $30 billion to extend tax credits under the Affordable Care Act (ACA) that expire at the end of 2025. Without renewal, the loss of these ACA subsidies would disproportionately hurt Americans in red states--where ACA enrollment is highest--starting January 1. Adding the subsidies to the resolution would only account for about .05% of the $5.7 trillion federal budget. We need the two parties to come to a reasonable compromise. History tells us it's possible. In 2013, under President Obama, **Rep. Paul Ryan** and **Sen. Patty Murray** cut through months of gridlock to forge the **[Bipartisan Budget Act of 2013](https://substack.com/redirect/741188cb-8e39-4fe9-9d37-866307930540?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --a deal that ended a 16-day government shutdown and set federal spending levels for the next two years. The final bill passed the House 332-94 and the Senate 64-36, with majorities of both parties voting yes.
# Economic Outlook
Meanwhile, **our national debt keeps climbing** , an unsustainable and immoral tab we're passing down to future generations.
The national debt has blown past **[$37.8 trillion](https://substack.com/redirect/93a8b79f-f925-4b55-898d-52890e831074?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and annual interest payments now top **$1.2 trillion** , more than we spend on defense. Even with **$202 billion in tariff revenue** , the government still ran a **$1.78 trillion deficit** this year. The debt-to-GDP (gross domestic product or total goods and services provided) ratio sits at **[99.9%](https://substack.com/redirect/0d5f1d43-14a2-4aba-80fa-72c428d93b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and that's in a relatively stable economy; one downturn or political crisis could send it spiraling.
We're closing in on a debt level not seen since the aftermath of World War II. In 1946, we rebuilt and rebounded, guided by fiscal policies that, over the next three decades, cemented our place as the world's economic leader. [By 1974, the national debt was just 23% of GDP](https://substack.com/redirect/27053241-21c5-49ae-8aed-8ef152b03779?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the U.S. dollar stood unchallenged as the global reserve currency. But now? We've reversed course.
As J.P. Morgan strategist David Kelly puts it, ["America is going broke slowly."](https://substack.com/redirect/77f7324a-4afd-49c8-89a4-c9ac2af68ee2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) My Hilco Global colleague Max Giuliana has an excellent article on [sovereign debt](https://substack.com/redirect/2bbff0da-36d6-4949-9184-a3efda3a568b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), noting that most advanced economies have matched or surpassed our debt-to-GDP ratios, and economists are sounding the alarm.
# Learn From Ancient History
If you're a lover of history, take note of the Roman Empire. The parallels are flashing red. Rome didn't fall because of invading barbarians alone. The real downfall came from economic decay and political dysfunction long before the Visigoths ever breached the gates. Military overreach, bloated spending, and heavy taxation strangled innovation and industry. Sound familiar?
The drivers we face today are clear:
* **An aging population.** In 1970, just 10% of Americans were 65 or older. Now, it's **[18%](https://substack.com/redirect/09a633d9-df80-4f95-9df0-1a92a567ac7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Today, [Social Security and Medicare consume about half of federal spending.](https://substack.com/redirect/af18e246-3b79-477e-b2bd-6c2dea699cef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Global militarization.** Defense spending worldwide increased **[$2.72 trillion in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/64e9a00f-20ce-4fa4-ad6c-b78e5333c7fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , the largest annual increase since 1988 (over 9%)
* **Populism and pessimism.** Over half of people polled from 31 countries believe their countries are in decline. (via [Ipsos 2025 report](https://substack.com/redirect/1b93ecc0-2ca3-43b0-adaa-bc835046a7f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

And as the dollar weakens--**[down 10% this year](https://substack.com/redirect/8df3e2d7-fa62-49ef-a6a3-5ada81d2b1c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --the American dream feels further out of reach. For too many, it's not a dream anymore. It's a debt trap nightmare.
As I stated on Fox News this week, young men are especially getting squeezed: 60% of young adult men still live at home, 400K of them had taken their own life the last twenty years, and buying a home used to cost twice your annual salary, now it's 5X.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9b6d0ed8-c8f3-431d-ae5c-0472efbd259a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
# Protests Across the Country
You can feel the frustration boiling over. Nearly seven million Americans took to the streets last Saturday for the "No Kings" rallies, a nationwide protest of Trump's authoritarian tactics, from masked ICE raids to federal troops in city streets, making it the largest single-day protest in U.S. history. For perspective, the first No Kings Rallies in June generated over five million protesters.
President Trump's reaction was to post an AI-generated video on his [Truth Social](https://substack.com/redirect/fafccdc0-2232-4bc1-866b-022705c9912a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) account depicting himself as a crowned fighter pilot in a jet labeled "King Trump," as he dumps poop onto crowds of protesters. At this point, the trolling doesn't bother me as much as his unwillingness to even talk or consult with the Democratic leadership while millions go without paychecks. Imagine being a TSA agent still working without pay and just watching this mess out of Washington.

But amid the noise, there's a flicker of hope--coming not from Washington, but from our local communities.
There's a new generation of leaders who are stepping up locally, many of them military veterans. Take **[Siddiq Kamara](https://substack.com/redirect/c4a198cc-ff30-4075-9458-57d14c238fb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , an immigrant, Army vet, and former law enforcement officer running for sheriff in Delaware County, PA, after losing his 8-year-old cousin to gun violence. Or **[Danny Ceisler](https://substack.com/redirect/596ecba9-fe0b-45e4-8bab-83129f618606?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , an Afghan War veteran and Bronze Star recipient running for sheriff in Bucks County. They're part of a new generation of everyday patriots who've had enough of partisanship. (Full disclosure: my PAC, Kennedy Democrats PA, has endorsed and supported both with a $25K contribution.)
They're not waiting for Washington to save America. They're stepping up to do it themselves.
And maybe that's where our political renewal begins, not in the capital, but in our local communities and states. We need to cultivate more leaders who believe public service is sacred.
We're less than two weeks from local and statewide races and a year from the 2026 midterms. History shows that the American electorate will counteract the disgrace they're seeing out of Washington. This year alone, **Democrats overperformed in 45 of 46 key elections** by an average of **15 points**.
History tells us this kind of overperformance--like we saw back in **2017 before the blue wave of 2018** --isn't random. It's a sign of a nation waking up. The Democrats were 24 seats away from taking back the House in the 2018 midterms; they won 40. In 2026, they are three seats away from taking back the House (which is why Trump is pushing redistricting in Texas, Indiana, and other Republican states, which is usually only ever done every decade).
So yes, the debt is dangerous. People are rightfully pissed off. The politics are exhausting and unproductive. The dream feels dim. But the story of America has always been of brushing against the abyss and doubling down towards progress.
The question is whether Washington will listen before the people make it impossible not to.
